Enter a model ID manually, or query the current provider and select one.
Used by both Translation and Summary requests. \'none\' disables thinking; other values are passed to OpenAI-compatible providers as reasoning_effort and mapped to an Anthropic thinking budget.
Conservative local token budget for the complete provider input, including system prompt and user content. Default: 16000.
Maximum concurrent Translation and Summary API requests. Valid range: 1 to 8.
Additional attempts after connection failures, timeouts, or retryable HTTP statuses. 0 disables network retries; allowed range: 0–5.
Additional repair requests when a model result cannot be parsed, fails validation, or contains invalid seq entries. 0 disables repairs; allowed range: 0–5. Each repair may incur API charges.
When enabled, the first block is repaired quickly and later content is repaired in increasing gradient blocks. When disabled, repairs and Quest delivery wait until the main response is complete.
Number of increasing repair blocks, from 2 to 8. A complete choice or if node is never split across blocks.
Use the full scene for repair context
Keeps full-scene context and generally improves consistency. Disable to send only the complete control-flow nodes covered by the current gradient block.

When disabled, an existing local scene file is preserved.
Parse only; would not send to API
Captures and writes a pending scene JSON without making an API request. Disable this option, restart the game, and revisit the scene to submit it.
Debug option. When a request ultimately fails after retries, saves the last response to scenes/failed/api_failed_<scene>.json. Request headers and the API key are never written.
Diagnostic option only. Leave it off during normal use.
HET keeps a schema-validated Scene mirror in its private files/scenes directory. When the game connects, Scene Sync reconciles the game and HET copies; manual refresh reloads local files first.
Game not running; refresh only reloads local Scene files.
Game connected; refresh reloads local files, then requests a complete Scene sync.
